name: Gap stick: turning every tick in a 45-wide shaft holds the dot up
techNote: A 45-wide shaft (x 0-45) between a left wall (top 500) and a right wall with a 76-tall notch (y 380-456) to a ledge (the finish). Jump right off the left wall's top into the shaft and fall; then turn every tick (stick -1, +1, ...): each turn swings the hitbox (offset x 5, width 41) 10 u sideways, the shaft (under 49 wide) has no room for it, so the front ground ray (x-25 or x+25) starts inside a wall and grounds the dot on every tick: Velocity.y is set to 0 and only one tick of gravity (-27) moves it, 0.54 u a tick down, pushed a little into the wall it faces. Shafts 41.5-48 wide stick this way, 49 does not; holding one way just falls. Stop wiggling and hold right: the dot falls on into the notch.
